desc: Deep Fictitious Play on URB. The equilibrium-seeking arm: nothing in the
previous twelve solves for a population distribution.
Source: Solving Continuous Mean Field Games, NeurIPS 2025, arXiv:2510.22158.
Host block == ippo/config1.json.
arm = fp    the paper's fictitious play: the population mix is averaged
with weight 1/(n+1) in FP ITERATIONS. 'ema' averages with rho instead
and 'br' removes the averaging entirely (the ablation).
fp_every = 10   days per FP iteration. The paper's inner loop trains a
best response against a frozen population; here that is ten days of
the host's own updates.
br_frac = 0.1   the anticipatory parameter: the fraction of decisions
taken by the best response rather than the average policy, so the BR
keeps seeing on-policy data. Heinrich & Silver's default.
rho = 0.99  only used by --arm ema.
avg_capacity = 2000   reservoir size for the average policy, which is
what makes it an average over history rather than a copy of the
latest best response.
field_scope = all   whose actions form the population. A same-OD
population is ONE traveller on six of URB's seven cities, so an
OD-scoped mean field carries no information (the measurement is in
mfq's FIELD-1).
The conditional normalizing flow of the paper is N/A here: the population
distribution is a point on the K-simplex and is represented exactly.
